result:
Each query is written from the page alone and none has been run. I guessed at these behaviours:
- `sort ~(/)` for a plain ascending sort.
- `groupBy ~(…)` with a key quote.
- Keys of a grouped map and of `entries` arriving as keywords.
- `split` keeping empty fields.
- `sum` of an empty vector answering 0.

R1: filter ~(/active) | filter ~(at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin") * /name | sort ~(/)
R2: filter ~(at :age | type | eq ::number) * /age | avg | round 2
R3: filter ~(/status | eq "paid") | groupBy ~(/customer) * (/ * (/items * (mul /qty /price) | sum) | sum | round 2)
R4: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login | coalesce "unassigned") * count
R5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) * /number | take 3
R6: [/dependencies /devDependencies] * entries | flat | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") * (/0 | keyword) | distinct | sort ~(/)
R7: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(split " " | /3 | parseJson | gte 500) * (split " " | /2) | distinct | sort ~(/)
R8: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "GET") * (split " " | /4 | split "ms" | /0 | parseJson) | avg | round 0
R9: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * split "," | filter ~(/2 | count | gt 0) | groupBy ~(/1) * (/ * (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)
R10: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) * (split "," | /3 | split ";") | flat | filter ~(count | gt 0) * lower | distinct | sort ~(/)
R11: lines | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~(split "=" | /0 | trim | startsWith "DB_") * (split "=" | [(/0 | trim | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (drop 1 | join "=" | trim)]) | tag ::map
R12: /services | filter ~(at :enabled | eq true) | entries * {:name (/0 | keyword) :url (/1 | :s / | /protocol | append "://" | append (s | /host) | append ":" | append (s | at :port | coalesce 80 | print))} | sort ~(/name)
R13: {:total (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * (at :meta | coalesce {} | at :amount | coalesce 0) | sum | round 2) :users (filter ~(/type | eq "purchase") * /user | distinct | count) :hasRefund (any ~(/type | lower | eq "refund"))}
R14: ["Apple" "banana" "apple" "Cherry" "BANANA" "date" "Elder" "cherry" "fig" "Apple"] | groupBy ~(lower) | filter ~(count | gt 1) | keys | sort ~(/) * keyword
